name: 1/2" Shackle
what: A U-shaped steel link with a screw-in pin. Connects a hoist, chain or sling to a truss or beam. Size is the bow's steel thickness; bigger = stronger.
specs: WLL 2 ton; hot-dip galvanized forged steel; screw pin

name: 1/4" to 1/4" Jumper
ref: Hosa HPP-003 REAN 1/4" TS to 1/4" TS, 3 ft
what: A short cable with a 1/4-inch plug on each end. Used to patch gear together, e.g. a keyboard or DI box into a mixer, or pedal to pedal.
specs: 1/4" TS male both ends; unbalanced; ~3 ft
notes: Your photo shows an unbranded cable; Hosa HPP-003 used as the price reference.

name: 16 X 4 - 25 ft. Snake (Fan to Box)
ref: Hosa SH-16X4-25 Pro-Conex stage box snake
what: One thick cable bundling many mic lines. The stage box sits on stage (mics plug in), the fan end plugs into the mixer. 16 x 4 = 16 inputs (sends) to the mixer and 4 returns back to stage for monitors.
specs: 16 XLR sends / 4 x 1/4" TRS returns; 25 ft

name: 16 X 4 Input - 50 ft. Snake (Fan to Box)
ref: Hosa SH-16X4-50 Pro-Conex stage box snake
what: Same as the 25 ft 16x4 snake, but 50 ft long so the mixer can sit farther from the stage (e.g. front-of-house in a bigger room).
specs: 16 XLR sends / 4 x 1/4" TRS returns; 50 ft

name: 1/8" Aux to Lightning Audio Headphone Jack Adapter
ref: Apple Lightning to 3.5 mm Headphone Jack Adapter (MMX62AM/A)
what: Lets an older iPhone/iPad (Lightning port) plug into a normal 1/8" (3.5 mm) aux cable, e.g. to play music into a mixer.
notes: Your photo shows a third-party adapter; Apple's version used as the price reference.

name: 1/8" Aux to USB C Audio Headphone Jack Adapter
ref: Apple USB-C to 3.5 mm Headphone Jack Adapter (MW2Q3AM/A)
what: Lets a USB-C phone, tablet or laptop plug into a normal 1/8" (3.5 mm) aux cable to send audio to a mixer or speaker.
notes: PRICE NOT CONFIRMED: couldn't read a live price. Check the Apple link.

name: 1/8" to Male XLR Cable (16")
ref: Kondor Blue KB-XLR35 XLR male to 3.5 mm male, 16"
what: Short cable that turns a 1/8" (3.5 mm) output into an XLR plug, e.g. feeding a wireless receiver or small device into a mixer or camera XLR input.
specs: 3.5 mm TRS male to 3-pin XLR male; 16 in

name: 1/8" TS Male to 1/4-inch TS Male Cable
ref: Hosa CMP-105 3.5 mm TRS to 1/4" TS, 5 ft
what: Connects a phone/laptop headphone output (1/8") to one 1/4" mixer input. Mono: left and right get combined into one channel.
specs: 3.5 mm male to 1/4" TS male; mono; 5 ft

name: 25' XLR
ref: Pro Co EXM-25 Excellines XLR cable, 25 ft
what: The standard pro audio cable. 3-pin, balanced (rejects noise). Carries mics to the snake/mixer and line signals to speakers. Female end connects to the source (mic), male end points toward the destination.
specs: 3-pin XLR F to XLR M; balanced; 25 ft
notes: You own 100 of these, the most of anything on page 1.
